destination.title: Euclidean wormholes and related gravitational instantons
destination.question: Which Euclidean wormholes and related instantons exist, and how do their quantum contributions, stability, holographic interpretation and effective interactions depend on the theory and regime?
destination.summary: A proposed research family spanning classical solutions, boundary prescriptions, quantum interpretation and applications. Numerical proximity supplies candidate membership, not common premises or an accepted physical conclusion.

systems: Complex scalar and massive charged-scalar wormhole models
Related gravitational instantons and reduction constructions
targets: Continuation, saddle admissibility and fluctuation stability
Symmetry breaking, phenomenology and proposed quantum-gravity bounds
regimes: Flat, AdS and positive-cosmological-constant cases, considered separately
Classical solutions and conditional semiclassical interpretations
assumptions: Every model retains its own matter content, boundary data and validity conditions
Classical existence does not establish a quantum contribution
conventions: Fixed-charge/flux and fixed-scalar Dirichlet problems remain distinct
Complex Euclidean fields do not automatically imply physical Lorentzian ghosts
includes: Alternate access to reduction methods, vacuum instantons and dS endpoints
excludes: A universal stability or admissibility verdict
Automatic equivalence of sources sharing an overview
An assumption that every construction is axionic, supersymmetric or UV complete

sources.title: Instantons and Wormholes for the Universal Hypermultiplet

evidence.text: How can fixed-axionic-charge transition amplitudes determine Euclidean continuation for noncommuting shifts, and yield universal-hypermultiplet instantons and wormholes with explicit supersymmetry and regularity conditions?

sources.title: Euclidean Actions, Instantons, Solitons and Supersymmetry

evidence.text: When do solutions of indefinite Euclidean axion actions define meaningful instanton contributions? How do definite scalar, indefinite scalar and dual tensor formulations relate, and when does instanton action equal the mass of a time-lifted soliton or black hole?

sources.title: Axion Wormholes in AdS Compactifications

evidence.text: Can exact, regular axionic Euclidean wormholes be embedded in an AdS string compactification whose scalar Wick rotation is fixed by AdS/CFT, and what would their existence imply for their admissibility in the gravitational path integral?

sources.title: Wormholes and masses for Goldstone bosons

evidence.text: Do Euclidean axion wormholes have admissible negative fluctuation modes, and what symmetry-breaking potential and phenomenological consequences follow? The paper also examines sensitivity to ultraviolet dynamics and extensions to Goldstone cosets.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: If regular wormholes occur in controlled AdS compactifications, how can their effects respect boundary factorization and positivity? The review leaves open whether topology change, the α prescription, the state, or the holographic dictionary must be revised.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: After gauge constraints and contour choices are imposed, does a Euclidean axion wormhole have a physical negative mode, and would it imply decay by baby-universe emission? The reviewed calculations disagree.

sources.title: Euclidean axion wormholes have multiple negative modes

evidence.text: Do macroscopic Euclidean axion wormholes possess physically meaningful negative modes under fixed-charge boundary conditions, and what would those modes imply for semiclassical charge-transition amplitudes and AdS/CFT factorization?

sources.title: Instantons, Euclidean wormholes and AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How should axion-induced Euclidean wormholes, extremal instantons and singular under-extremal saddles be interpreted in quantum gravity and AdS/CFT, and which can contribute to the path integral?

sources.title: Comments on wormholes, ensembles, and cosmology

evidence.text: How can conventional higher-dimensional holographic theories describe Euclidean AdS wormholes and the closed big-bang/big-crunch cosmologies obtained by analytic continuation? Which features of Black Hole Microstate Cosmology (BHMC) support this interpretation and possible generalizations?

sources.title: The axion quality problem: global symmetry breaking and wormholes

evidence.text: How strongly do Euclidean gravitational wormholes break continuous global symmetries, and do their actions preserve Peccei–Quinn axion quality? The paper also asks how an extended global symmetry and an open-string axion–dilaton system change the answer when radial modes are dynamical.

sources.title: Instantons and no wormholes in $AdS_3\times S^3 \times CY_2$

evidence.text: Classify O(3)-symmetric Euclidean instantons sourced by AdS axion-saxion moduli, determine whether regular wormholes exist, and identify the brane interpretation of extremal solutions.

sources.title: Complex saddles and Euclidean wormholes in the Lorentzian path integral

evidence.text: Which complex saddles contribute to Lorentzian axion-gravity transition amplitudes, how can bilocal terms change their selection, and is the Giddings–Strominger (GS) wormhole perturbatively stable with the appropriate boundary conditions?

sources.title: Axion wormholes with massive dilaton

evidence.text: How does stabilizing the dilaton change Euclidean axion instantons, wormhole necks, dilaton excursions and action-to-charge ratios, and do these corrections support the proposed axionic weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: A 10d construction of Euclidean axion wormholes in flat and AdS space

evidence.text: Can regular axion-supported Euclidean wormholes be explicitly lifted to ten dimensions with parametrically small curvature and coupling despite Planck-scale scalar excursions, and what holographic positivity puzzle remains for explicit AdS examples?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Wormholes in String Theory

evidence.text: Can regular supersymmetric Euclidean wormholes admitting a string-theory embedding be constructed and classified within an AdS5 supergravity truncation, and what boundary data and on-shell action determine their possible gravitational path-integral role?

sources.title: Axionic wormholes with <math display="inline"><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> correction in metric and Palatini formulations

evidence.text: How does an R² correction change axionic wormhole solutions, their actions and the estimated explicit Peccei-Quinn violation, and how do these effects depend on choosing metric or Palatini gravity?

sources.title: Black hole — wormhole transitions in two dimensional string theory

evidence.text: When do charged Euclidean wormholes dominate over two disconnected near-extremal black holes in two-dimensional Type 0A/IIA string theory, and what worldsheet or matrix descriptions might determine whether this competition survives string corrections?

sources.title: Cosmology of gravitational axions

evidence.text: Can nonperturbative Euclidean wormholes generate a cosmologically relevant mass for the gravitational Chern–Simons axion, allowing dark matter or dynamical dark energy, and what gravitational-wave or compact-object signatures follow?

sources.title: Non-extremal D-instantons and the AdS/CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Construct non-extremal D-instantons asymptotic to AdS5 × S5, determine their holographic axion/dilaton one-point functions and possible Yang–Mills interpretation, and investigate whether their Euclidean wormholes yield closed Lorentzian cosmologies.

sources.title: Wormholes made without massless matter fields

evidence.text: Can Euclidean wormholes exist without massless matter fields, and how do their charge, throat size, and effective operator insertions behave in a theory containing only a massive charged scalar and gravity?

sources.title: Instantons and Wormholes for the Universal Hypermultiplet

evidence.text: Generalize the Coleman–Lee prescription by projecting initial and final states onto compatible axionic charge-density eigenspaces. The resulting surface term Σ changes the boundary variational problem; its boundary conditions force complex axionic saddles and specify which fields are analytically continued.

sources.title: Euclidean Actions, Instantons, Solitons and Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Use Hodge dualization and completion of squares for the tensor Bogomol'nyi bound. Obtain the Euclidean BPS projection from zero eigenvectors of the supersymmetry anticommutator matrix, then impose vanishing fermion variations on scalar backgrounds.

sources.title: Axion Wormholes in AdS Compactifications

evidence.text: Reduce the scalar equations for an SO(D)-invariant geometry to affine geodesic motion on the scalar manifold, with conserved norm c. Use the radial gravitational constraint and compare the required end-to-end scalar distance with the available timelike geodesic length.

sources.title: Wormholes and masses for Goldstone bosons

evidence.text: Scalar-vector-tensor decomposition and Hamiltonian constraint reduction isolate physical perturbations. A gauge-invariant canonical transformation addresses the homogeneous conformal-factor problem; Schrödinger operators with Pöschl–Teller potentials supply the fluctuation spectra.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Derive the reparametrization constraint, reinterpret its solution as a field, and introduce interactions representing topology change. This supplies a dynamical alternative to simply integrating static α parameters.

sources.title: Euclidean axion wormholes have multiple negative modes

evidence.text: The stability argument uses trial fluctuations, including ΠX=1/cosh(4ρ), rather than diagonalizing the Sturm–Liouville operator. For Λ<0, the background and perturbation coefficients are examined numerically in conformal gauge.

sources.title: Instantons and wormholes in Minkowski and (A)dS spaces

evidence.text: When do Euclidean instantons and nonsingular, finite-action wormholes exist in d-dimensional axion-dilaton gravity with zero, negative or positive cosmological constant, and how does existence depend on the dilaton coupling?

sources.title: Axion-de Sitter wormholes

evidence.text: What regular Euclidean axion wormholes exist with positive cosmological constant, how stable and semiclassically weighted are they, and can their Lorentzian continuations describe quantum bridges between expanding de Sitter-like universes?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Can the axion and dilaton fields of a string compactification support a smooth Euclidean throat? The relevant classical equations use an indefinite scalar metric obtained by continuing the axionic variables while retaining ordinary dilaton kinetic signs.

sources.title: A comment on no-force conditions for black holes and branes

evidence.text: How does timelike reduction explain no-force conditions for black holes and branes whose surface gravity or horizon area vanishes, and what heuristic lesson does the same formalism offer for axion instantons and Euclidean wormholes?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: The AdS3 × S3 × T4 background supplies a known holographic laboratory in which a small, regular string wormhole could be tested against the properties of an ordinary finite-charge quantum system.

sources.title: Stability of axion-saxion wormholes

evidence.text: Are asymptotically flat Euclidean axion wormholes perturbatively stable when coupled to a massless saxion, and do scalar and Hodge-dual two-form descriptions agree under correctly implemented fixed-flux boundary conditions?

sources.title: Positivity of the gravitational path integral implies the axionic weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Does positivity of gravitational path-integral inner products constrain axion shift-symmetry breaking strongly enough to yield an axionic weak gravity bound with numerical coefficients?

sources.title: Wormholes and the imaginary distance bound

evidence.text: Does the appearance of wormholes supported by imaginary scalar fields bound analytic continuation of a single gravitational theory's couplings, and do intrinsic string-theory effects invalidate its low-energy description at or before that bound?

sources.title: Wormholes in Maximal Supergravity

evidence.text: Do complex Euclidean wormholes exist in compactified supergravity, and can string theory include their saddle-point contributions? The paper distinguishes the classical existence problem from the compatibility of a complex integration contour with discrete gauge symmetry.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Do Euclidean wormholes contribute to physical quantum gravity, and can their effects coexist with local effective field theory? The review treats censorship, baby-universe states, and the interpretation of coupling constants as unresolved questions even for large, low-curvature configurations.

sources.title: Wormhole fragmentation and the axion Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can nonperturbative fragmentation of Euclidean axion wormholes into charged defects motivate the axion Weak Gravity Conjecture with a definite order-one coefficient, and how does the condition relate to the Imaginary Distance Bound?

sources.title: Non-extremal instantons and wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Which non-extremal, spherically symmetric Euclidean gravity–dilaton–axion solutions exist, when are they completely regular wormholes, and can such wormholes occur in Calabi–Yau compactifications of string theory?

sources.title: My Personal History With the Quantum Theory of de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Clarify the author's account of the history of finite-state de Sitter quantum theory and explain its implications for locality, the limits of QFT and the information accessible to physical detectors.

sources.title: Some thoughts on the quantum theory of de sitter space

evidence.text: What can semiclassical gravity and self-consistent measurement theory say about a hypothetical finite-state quantum theory of de Sitter space, its observables, mathematical ambiguities and flat-space limit? The paper summarizes two lectures and presents an exploratory toy model.

sources.title: Recurrent nightmares? Measurement theory in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Assuming asymptotic de Sitter space has finitely many quantum states, what can internal observers measure, can Poincaré recurrences be verified, and can measurements select a unique mathematical dynamics?

sources.title: Finite number of states, de Sitter space and quantum groups at roots of unity

evidence.text: Can root-of-unity deformations furnish finite-state toy models that support cosmological supersymmetry breaking, especially a breaking scale parametrically larger than the deformation scale? The paper also explores analogies with de Sitter black holes and sign-dependent state counting.

sources.title: Some thoughts on the quantum theory of stable de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can a finite-state quantum theory of stable de Sitter space reproduce semiclassical local physics and explain cosmological supersymmetry breaking (CSB), including its dependence on the cosmological constant?

sources.title: My Personal History With the Quantum Theory of de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Review a hydrodynamic interpretation of geometry based on causal-diamond area laws. The Carlip–Solodukhin construction is described through a 1+1-dimensional CFT with central charge proportional to screen area and modular Hamiltonian identified with its L0 generator.

sources.title: Some thoughts on the quantum theory of de sitter space

evidence.text: The toy model quantizes a complex N×(N+1) fuzzy-sphere spinor matrix as fermions. Half-filled sectors and block restrictions represent vacuum and black-hole configurations in an approximate Hamiltonian commuting with fermion number.

sources.title: Recurrent nightmares? Measurement theory in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Local apparatus is modelled by many local Hilbert-space factors. Macrostates differing in a finite fraction of factors have overlaps given by products of local overlaps, estimated as Nap^(−p), with Nap=n^k and p of order one.

sources.title: Finite number of states, de Sitter space and quantum groups at roots of unity

evidence.text: Use a Bogolyubov transformation for the undeformed quadratic noncommutative model. Separately, adopt the quantum-group Casimir as a Hamiltonian and study finite representation sums and low/high-temperature partition-function expansions.

sources.title: Some thoughts on the quantum theory of stable de Sitter space

evidence.text: Use Euclidean Hartle–Hawking path integrals, expand the logarithm of the wavefunctional in boundary fields, and analytically continue to future infinity. Boundary scaling data provide the proposed perturbative gauge-invariant mass diagnostic.

sources.title: My Personal History With the Quantum Theory of de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Use detector-resource arguments: semiclassical collective variables have uncertainties scaling as N⁻¹, histories with exponentially suppressed interference and lifetimes sufficient for repeated measurements in different bases. The author infers that a detector resolving an M-dimensional system requires Hilbert-space dimension much greater than M.

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: How should one ask what observers could have measured if a now-known quantity had been unknown? The paper requires a physical specification of which records may vary and which features continue to identify the conditioning system.

sources.title: A Critique of pure string theory: Heterodox opinions of diverse dimensions

evidence.text: How should black-hole dominance reshape background independence, vacuum selection, and the cosmological constant problem, and can finite-state de Sitter quantum mechanics explain supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Unruh-DeWitt detector responses for complex scalar fields in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: What response does a comoving pointlike Unruh–DeWitt detector have when quadratically coupled to a complex scalar in de Sitter spacetime, and how do regularization, massless minimal coupling, and α-vacuum choice affect its interpretation?

sources.title: Symmetries, matrices, and de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: Which reduced spacetime symmetries could support a matrix description of de Sitter gravity, do IMF-like and DLCQ-like constructions agree, and can a Newton-Hooke matrix model account for holographic scaling and a possible transition between infinite and finite Hilbert spaces?

sources.title: De Sitter holography with a finite number of states

evidence.text: Can de Sitter holography have finitely many observer-accessible states, a unitary S-matrix, and de Sitter symmetry despite the obstruction to nontrivial finite-dimensional unitary representations of the de Sitter group?

sources.title: Adventures in de Sitter space

evidence.text: What do semiclassical horizon thermodynamics, entropy bounds and Nariai instabilities imply for possible quantum descriptions of de Sitter space? This is a selective survey of results and open problems.

sources.title: De sitter space with finitely many states: A Toy story

evidence.text: Can finite-dimensional de Sitter state spaces support a unitary, de Sitter-invariant S-matrix if the Hamiltonian need not be Hermitian and symmetry generators may mix incoming and outgoing states?

sources.title: Thermal derivation of the Coleman-De Luccia tunneling prescription

evidence.text: Determine a decay rate and post-transition initial conditions from a thermal scalar theory confined to a de Sitter causal diamond. The central issue is whether the usual Euclidean prescription requires information outside the observer's horizon.

sources.title: Festina Lente: EFT Constraints from Charged Black Hole Evaporation in de Sitter

evidence.text: Must every black-hole perturbation of a long-lived de Sitter static patch eventually equilibrate back to empty de Sitter?

sources.title: De Sitter Stability and Coarse Graining

evidence.text: Does de Sitter space remain self-consistent under semiclassical back reaction when the gravitational source is calculated after tracing over states beyond a local observer’s cosmological event horizon?

sources.title: De Sitter Musings

evidence.text: How should observables, horizon entropy and quantum gravity be formulated in asymptotically de Sitter space, distinguishing a static-patch observer from a metaobserver accessing future-boundary data?

sources.title: Clock Fields and Logarithmic Decay of Dark Energy

evidence.text: Is the infrared screening of de Sitter expansion in the reviewed conformal-mode formalism locally measurable, and how does an independent clock field change that conclusion?

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Can metastable de Sitter space receive a potentially rigorous quantum definition as a resonance in transition amplitudes between particular excited states of asymptotically supersymmetric flat vacua? The diagnostic is a pole in a spectral representation of such an amplitude.

sources.title: Supersymmetric dS/CFT

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric Euclidean vector models define a well-behaved Hartle-Hawking wavefunction through dS/CFT, providing evidence for stable supersymmetric de Sitter space in higher-spin gravity?

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: DS/dS proposes that gravity in a D-dimensional de Sitter bulk is described by two cutoff CFTs coupled to gravity on a d = D − 1 de Sitter slice.

sources.title: On the Positivity of de Sitter Group Averaging

evidence.text: On which domains is the de Sitter group-averaging inner product positive semidefinite, so that it can implement gravitational linearization-stability constraints? Does absolute convergence alone ensure positivity?

sources.title: De Sitter holography with a finite number of states

evidence.text: Can de Sitter holography have finitely many observer-accessible states, a unitary S-matrix, and de Sitter symmetry despite the obstruction to nontrivial finite-dimensional unitary representations of the de Sitter group?

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Constrained instantons deform the tensionless CDL geometry by separating the two nucleation events. The constraint fixes their proper-time separation along ψ=0. These deformed geometries are off shell relative to the original CDL equations; a minisuperspace integral over their separation supplies the leading contribution.

sources.title: Supersymmetric dS/CFT

evidence.text: Gaussian integration exchanges numerator and denominator determinants relative to ordinary-statistics U(N), giving inverse partition functions. The mass-dependent product is evaluated numerically through the second derivative of the free energy.

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: Solve the regular cap problem for each r*, continue to the UV slice, extract boundary data, and integrate the reduced area over both sides. The packet reports the outcome without solver, tolerance, or convergence information.

sources.title: On the Positivity of de Sitter Group Averaging

evidence.text: For three complementary-series particles, analytically continues principal-series coefficients with Knapp–Stein normalization factors. The higher-dimensional proof expresses the inner product through a Hermitian channel matrix M: M is the identity at Δi=(d−1)/2, and continuity plus invertibility prevent its eigenvalues from changing sign.

sources.title: De Sitter holography with a finite number of states

evidence.text: Decompose tensor products of antipodal Fock states into de Sitter representations, extract singlets, reinterpret their coefficients as S-matrix amplitudes, and impose unitarity on those coefficients. Observer bases are organized using rotation Casimirs and Clebsch–Gordan coefficients.

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Infinite-volume action divergences are regulated using constant transverse-size surfaces that respect de Sitter and Lorentz boost symmetries. The t0-independent reference action S0 is subtracted and its exponential absorbed into the amplitude's overall normalization.

sources.title: De Sitter space and eternity

evidence.text: Can infrared quantum effects prevent de Sitter space from being an eternal background, and could the resulting instability support cosmological-constant screening and a gauge/string description?

sources.title: Quantum global structure of de Sitter space

evidence.text: Does the simple global structure of classical de Sitter space survive black-hole nucleation and quantum radiation, and what would fragmentation of future infinity imply for proposed holographic surfaces?

sources.title: Symmetries, matrices, and de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: Which reduced spacetime symmetries could support a matrix description of de Sitter gravity, do IMF-like and DLCQ-like constructions agree, and can a Newton-Hooke matrix model account for holographic scaling and a possible transition between infinite and finite Hilbert spaces?

sources.title: Adventures in de Sitter space

evidence.text: What do semiclassical horizon thermodynamics, entropy bounds and Nariai instabilities imply for possible quantum descriptions of de Sitter space? This is a selective survey of results and open problems.

sources.title: Les Houches lectures on de Sitter space

evidence.text: Review classical de Sitter geometry, free scalar quantum field theory, horizon temperature and entropy as background for de Sitter quantum gravity; explain the conformal asymptotic symmetry underlying the proposed dS/CFT correspondence and derive suitable metric falloffs.

sources.title: De sitter space with finitely many states: A Toy story

evidence.text: Can finite-dimensional de Sitter state spaces support a unitary, de Sitter-invariant S-matrix if the Hamiltonian need not be Hermitian and symmetry generators may mix incoming and outgoing states?

sources.title: Finite number of states, de Sitter space and quantum groups at roots of unity

evidence.text: Can root-of-unity deformations furnish finite-state toy models that support cosmological supersymmetry breaking, especially a breaking scale parametrically larger than the deformation scale? The paper also explores analogies with de Sitter black holes and sign-dependent state counting.

sources.title: Some thoughts on the quantum theory of de sitter space

evidence.text: What can semiclassical gravity and self-consistent measurement theory say about a hypothetical finite-state quantum theory of de Sitter space, its observables, mathematical ambiguities and flat-space limit? The paper summarizes two lectures and presents an exploratory toy model.

sources.title: Higher Spin de Sitter Hilbert Space

evidence.text: Can minimal higher-spin de Sitter gravity receive a microscopic Hilbert space, operator algebra and normalizable Hartle–Hawking state that reproduce perturbative expectations while defining nonperturbative probabilities?

sources.title: De Sitter Musings

evidence.text: How should observables, horizon entropy and quantum gravity be formulated in asymptotically de Sitter space, distinguishing a static-patch observer from a metaobserver accessing future-boundary data?
